The current implementation always overwrites all fields with `updates.title as any`, etc., even if the field is `undefined` in the update. This means if I only update `title`, then `description`, `priority`, `status`, and `dueDate` will all be set to `undefined`.

The fix is to only spread fields that are actually defined in the update, or to use a conditional spread pattern. Let me also note that `description` defaults to `""` when creating a task, and `dueDate` defaults to `null`. So if someone passes `dueDate: null` explicitly, we want to set it to null (clear it). The fix needs to be careful about this — we should treat `undefined` as "don't update" and any other value (including `null`) as "update to this value".
